metadata.description: Reviewed fork of Marco Carnevali's mods for Claude Code: panes, bands and hooks that run inside the terminal and the desktop app

plugins.name: github-issues
plugins.description: A side pane listing the repository's GitHub issues, with one click to have Claude work on one

plugins.name: task-board
plugins.description: A To do / Doing / Done board in a side pane, filled by Claude's to-do list, approved plans and a board tool, plus your own cards
